remarks: Move right into this storybook 3300SF Nantucket-style cape on lovely in-town cul-de-sac minutes to town and train. Recently reimagined and updated with great style and sophistication, this fabulous 5 bedroom 4.5 bath home has a flexible floor plan for easy living , working and comfortable entertaining. Extensive list of improvements is available. Notably the addition of a full bath and laundry room on the second floor, creation of first floor powder room, new mudroom with built-in cubbies, new propane fired HVAC system, new roof, kitchen refresh...the list goes on and on. The park-like setting with new landscaping, lovely gardens, bluestone terrace, new fencing and a large play yard is private and inviting. A GEM!!!
